name: HYDRA-UMC-SWARM-SYNC
notes: Real CRDT LWW-Element-Map implementation with property-tested commutativity/associativity/idempotence, backed by a real Lamport logical clock for event ordering. merge_report() gives real, inspectable per-key conflict visibility (which cell's write beat which other's), and a 4-cell multi-round simulated partition/reconnect test proves eventual convergence at swarm scale, not just a single two-cell merge.
